contract.purpose: Return load Insight header and summary values.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE PROCEDURE INV_LoadInsightDetailPaneData(@internalLoadNum numeric(9)) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: NULL or absent load produces two empty result sets. Both TOP 1 selections lack ordering.
output_shape: Two result sets: SCALAR/HEADER_INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM/CARRIER/ScheduledShipDate/LEADING_STS/TRAILING_STS/WAREHOUSE; then SCALAR/TotalShipments/TotalContainers/TotalLines. NOCOUNT ON.

ordered_branches.explanation: Materialize matching load-view rows by internal load identity.
Return TOP 1 carrier/date/warehouse and translated leading/trailing statuses, then TOP 1 stored shipment/container totals plus a live count of shipment-detail lines.
